trigger_requirement: Run only if the frozen source-only L condition actually produces at least one manually source-adjudicated unsupported/contradicted fact or technical EN/PT divergence. If none, preserve that finding and skip this false-support study instead of spending calls without negative cases.
hypothesis: Generic/role-aware source verifiers that perform on authored controls may still accept correlated errors from the same local model actual source-extraction outputs. Measure label and source-sound rationale, without automatic assembly or output correction.
selection_frozen_now: Complete all3Lrequests or preserve transport stop; read original available fact strings against unchanged source/reference ledger. Do not repair/fill missing outputs.
For each task, sort factual IDs lexicographically; choose up to2generated fact pairs adjudicated CONTRADICTED or INSUFFICIENT, then up to1SUPPORTED fact pair in that same task.

At most3pairs per task,9unique pairs overall,18critic requests (two fixed conditions per pair). Record all unselected and missing cases with reasons; no quality-based choice after seeing critic predictions.
If a task has no unsupported pair, retain its up-to1supported control only when the overall study has at least one unsupported pair; no generic overall accuracy claim.
reference_unit: One original Lfact pair judged SUPPORTED only when both EN/PT preserve its source proposition/conditions; any concrete source contradiction or code-identifier change is CONTRADICTED, unresolved meaning/context is INSUFFICIENT. Ordinary accurate translated prose is not automatically an identifier error.
prompt_conditions: Reuse the frozen V/Rsystem instructions, plus identical note in both conditions to judge every part of the original EN/PT pair. Same pinned source cards/model/options350token critic bound; never include evaluator labels/reference answers in critic request. Freeze exact selected requests/hashes before any critic calls.
metrics: Separate selected real-generated-claim cohort, raw-label confusion matrices, false support/rejection, justified/unjustified abstention and rationale soundness. Missing/invalid/transport outcomes explicit. Do not pool with18authored ENcontrols, Kcopies or historical whole notes.
independence_limit: Same local generator/verifier model and exposed families; this is correlated self-verification research, not independent human/owner review or held-out semantic evaluation.
document_gate: Manual source gate remains authoritative for research admission. A critic SUPPORTED label must not override a known false claim; no model-only publication or Gold promotion.
